LanguageData.VRE_AncientAstrosuit.description: A resilient relic from the spacer astronaut era. Offers unmatched insulation and near total fire resistance, safeguarding wearers from environmental hazards in space. Its outdated design significantly hampers movement, making wearers slow and less agile. Despite its minimal armor capabilities, its historical significance as a piece of early space exploration history remains undiminished.
LanguageData.VRE_AncientAstrosuit.label: ancient astrosuit
